description: This file implements a custom decision tree class with methods for conversion, pruning, visualization, prediction, and code generation, mimicking some sklearn API functionalities.

classes.name: DecisionTreeNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the decision tree, including feature, threshold, child nodes, class probabilities, and sample count.

classes.name: DecisionTree
classes.description: A custom decision tree class that supports conversion from sklearn, pruning, visualization, prediction, and code generation.

methods.name: _convert_sklearn_tree
methods.description: Converts a sklearn tree structure into custom DecisionTreeNode instances recursively.

methods.name: prune
methods.description: Prunes the tree based on a dataframe, target column, and minimum class count per node.

methods.name: _prune_tree
methods.description: Recursively prunes the tree nodes based on class diversity in subtrees.

methods.name: to_dot
methods.description: Generates a Graphviz dot representation of the decision tree.

methods.name: _node_to_dot
methods.description: Recursively creates dot nodes and edges for visualization.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts class labels for input data.

methods.name: predict_proba
methods.description: Predicts class probabilities for input data.

methods.name: _get_leaf
methods.description: Traverses the tree to find the leaf node for a given input.

methods.name: _predict_single
methods.description: Predicts class label for a single input sample.

methods.name: _predict_proba_single
methods.description: Predicts class probabilities for a single input sample.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Returns node IDs for each input sample.

methods.name: _apply_single
methods.description: Returns the node ID for a single input sample.

methods.name: codegen
methods.description: Generates Python code representing the decision tree logic.
